intro: In Stormwind Keep, Lord Baurles K. Wishock lives among the petitioners and dignitaries. Barkeeps know him for unpaid tabs and a taste for strong drink, but his nights in the city’s underbelly brought him near darker dealings.

p: Lord Baurles K. Wishock moves among petitioners and dignitaries in Stormwind Keep, where he belongs to the influential House of Nobles. Though his station is high, he often drinks in the Mage Quarter’s dive bars, especially the Slaughtered Lamb, and leaves large bills unpaid. There, he hears of a warlock coven practicing dark arts in cellars beneath the floorboards. Wishock sets out to have the tavern closed and asks fellow nobles for a formal investigation. Uncovering demonic cabals in Stormwind rarely goes unpunished.
